name: Bieuzy
text: Saint Bieuzy was a holy man remembered across Brittany. He stands as the patron of a sacred spring, the holy well of Bieuzy. Traditions say the waters of that well carry healing power. The faithful seek its waters for ease of a troubled mind. The folk of Brittany count this spring among the most honoured of all their holy wells.

attributes.attribute: waters held to cure a troubled mind
ranks among famous Breton holy wells

okr.objective: Tell who Saint Bieuzy was and why his well matters.
key_results: Bieuzy is remembered as a Breton saint.
He acts as patron of the sacred well bearing his name.
The well's waters are held to cure a troubled mind.
Bretons count the well among their most celebrated holy places.
